ARABIC — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: ARABIC
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Conversational Skills: Interviews, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Conversational Skills: Interviews.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills: Interviews.

2. When practising Reading Fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading Fluency.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Reading Fluency.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading Fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Reading Fluency.

3. When practising Public Speaking, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Public Speaking.

5. When practising Reading for Information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Information.

6. When practising Listening for information, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Listening for information.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Listening for information.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Listening for information.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Listening for information.

7. When practising Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills.

8. When practising Reading for Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Reading for Comprehension.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Reading for Comprehension.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Reading for Comprehension.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Reading for Comprehension.

9. In ARABIC, the best classroom habit is: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid speaking to classmates
   B. Mix random languages with no purpose
   C. Only memorise without using the language
   D. Practise listening, speaking, reading, and writing every day

10. When practising Intensive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)

   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Conversational Skills: Etiquette.

   D. Use insults to “practise” Conversational Skills: Etiquette.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
12. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and Critical Reading Skills and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Study Skills: The Reading Process and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Extensive Reading and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Mechanics of Writing: The Arabic Calligraphy and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
